explication: SGLang is a high-performance serving framework for language, multimodal, and diffusion models. The principal flow is client request → gateway pipeline → SGLang engine → model execution → streamed response. Configuration resolution, caching, GPU kernels, multimodal preprocessing, LoRA, distributed execution, and router-side load-aware selection form the main internal layers. The tree and excerpts show several branches, but not every runtime call; uncertain cross-subsystem wiring is therefore omitted or marked optional.
